WITH base AS (

    SELECT
        t.*,

        date_format(
            from_unixtime(
                t.timestamp / 1000,
                'Asia/Seoul'
            ),
            '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s'
        ) AS kst_time,

        element_at(
            multimap_from_entries(
                transform(
                    t.httprequest.headers,
                    x -> (
                        lower(x.name),
                        x.value
                    )
                )
            ),
            'host'
        )[1] AS host_domain,

        element_at(
            multimap_from_entries(
                transform(
                    t.httprequest.headers,
                    x -> (
                        lower(x.name),
                        x.value
                    )
                )
            ),
            'user-agent'
        )[1] AS user_agent,

        json_format(
            CAST(
                t.httprequest.headers
                AS JSON
            )
        ) AS all_headers

    FROM ons_lotte t

)


SELECT

    httprequest.uri,
    count(*) AS hit_count

FROM base

WHERE

kst_time BETWEEN
'2026-08-05 17:45:02'
AND
'2026-08-06 17:45:02'


GROUP BY 1

ORDER BY hit_count DESC

LIMIT 10
